QuestInfo.name: [Karote] Reunion
QuestInfo.0:
At the summit, you discovered what's been striking the tower down over and over.
It's #bKalos#k, a machine who guards a hidden, flying laboratory.
#bKalos#k recognizes you as the vessel of the Adversary.
But it's hostile to #bNicky#k. See if you can find out why.
QuestInfo.2: #bNicky#k has revealed his true identity; #rT-Boy#k from the #rAngler Company#k.
